# Cendrix Capital — Complete Platform & Technical Reference

> Institutional-grade paper trading platform and Indian stock market simulator built for retail and quantitative traders to practice execution with zero capital risk.

## 1. Overview
Cendrix Capital (CNRX) is a high-fidelity virtual paper trading platform designed to bridge the gap between simulation and real-world trading. While generic paper trading apps use arbitrary fills, synthetic random-walk curves, and zero-friction accounting, Cendrix Capital enforces authentic exchange leverage, statutory transaction taxes (STT, CTT, GST, Stamp Duty), and strict in-memory order execution matching.

## 2. Core Market Segments & Specifications

### 2.1 Indian Equities (NSE Cash)
- Large-cap, mid-cap, and index equities including RELIANCE, HDFCBANK, TCS, INFY, ICICIBANK, and TATASTEEL.
- Product Types:
  - MIS (Margin Intraday Square-off): 5x verified leverage with mandatory daily square-off.
  - CNC (Cash and Carry): 1x delivery margin requirement.

### 2.2 Equity Index & Stock Derivatives (NSE F&O)
- NIFTY 50 and BANKNIFTY contracts with authentic contract multiplier, tick size, and lot sizing.
- Order Types: MARKET, LIMIT, SL (Stop-Loss), and SL-M (Stop-Loss Market).
- Product Types: MIS (Intraday) and NRML (Normal carry-forward).

### 2.3 Commodities & Bullion (MCX)
- Dedicated commodities trading desk for precious metals, energy, and base metals.
- Contract Specs:
  - GOLDM: Gold Mini 100g contract.
  - SILVERM: Silver Mini 5kg contract.
  - CRUDEOIL: Crude Oil 100 BBL contract.
  - NATURALGAS: Natural Gas 1250 mmBtu contract.

## 3. Order Execution & Matching Engine
- In-memory event bus matching orders against live market bid/ask spreads.
- Strict price-time priority execution.
- Real-time margin validation: orders are rejected if available margin is insufficient.

## 4. Statutory Friction & Regulatory Tax Deductions
To ensure paper trading performance accurately reflects live market reality, Cendrix Capital models all statutory Indian exchange charges:
- STT (Securities Transaction Tax) / CTT (Commodities Transaction Tax)
- GST (Goods and Services Tax on brokerage and transaction charges)
- Exchange Transaction Turnover Charges
- SEBI Turnover Fees
- State Stamp Duty Charges

## 5. Quantitative Analytics & Journaling
- Double-entry audited cash ledger preserving every credit, debit, margin block, and settlement.
- Comprehensive telemetry: Win Rate %, Profit Factor, Max Peak-to-Trough Drawdown, Average R:R Ratio, and Session Volatility.
- One-click CSV statement export for strategy backtesting and external trade audits.

## 6. Access & Security
- Instant 1-Click Institutional Auto-Connect for frictionless trial.
- Zero-trust architecture: user session tokens encrypted, trading data securely stored.
- Web Application: Hosted at https://cendrix-capital-stf.vercel.app/
